keyframes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 handmade felt-diorama action keyframe. The recurring white felt bunny with red round glasses rides a red four-wheel skateboard through the same gray felt security corridor, holding the same compact cream felt fantasy gat. Exact start state: front foot bears weight on the deck over the front truck; rear foot is visibly planted on the ground behind the board at the beginning of one push; all four wheels contact the ground; knees and hips balance the forward acceleration; three wall cameras are intact. Keep the support polygon, foot contacts, wheel contacts, grip, direction of travel, and clearance fully visible.

Same vertical felt corridor, bunny, red glasses, cream felt gat, and red skateboard. Exact coast state after the push: both feet are planted on the deck over the trucks, all four wheels contact the ground, knees flex for balance, the free arm counters motion, and the gat is raised toward the nearest intact wall camera. No camera has transformed yet. This must join continuously from the push state and into the trigger state without changing identity, count, grip, board, or direction of travel.

Same vertical felt corridor and exact character, prop, board, and travel direction. Exact recoil-settle end state: both feet remain planted on the rolling deck over the trucks, all four wheels stay grounded, the grip remains closed around the compact felt gat, and the body shows a small mechanically credible counter-response. Only the nearest mounted camera has one contained dandelion flower at its lens; its housing and bracket remain attached. The other cameras remain intact.

Vertical target-side macro in the same handmade felt security corridor. The nearest wall camera dominates the foreground with lens intact, housing closed, and bracket visibly mounted. In the background the same bunny continues forward on the same red skateboard, both feet on the deck and wheels on the ground, aiming the same compact cream felt gat along a clear force line toward the lens. No flower, debris, smoke, or completed effect yet.

Exact end state of the target-side macro. Preserve the same camera housing and mounted bracket; a dense contained bouquet of yellow dandelions and white seed heads now grows from inside the lens opening instead of replacing or detaching the camera. The same bunny and red skateboard have moved farther forward down the corridor; both feet remain supported by the deck and the wheels remain grounded. Show settled stems and a few drifting seeds, with no metal debris, smoke, or reset.
